item.title: BGCT Executive Board approves CP task force
item.description: The Baptist General Convention of Texas Executive Board approved the creation of three new task forces and approved committee and board nominees and two relationship agreements.

item.title: Voices: The significance of Black hymns for all Christians
item.description: Dr. Roy Cotton Sr. shares the significance of Black hymns and hymnodists to the musical and devotional life of Baptists and all Christians.

item.title: Connect360: Sing and Shout to the Lord!
item.description: Lesson One in the Connect360 unit “Psalms: The Believer’s Prayer Book” focuses on Psalm 66:1–20.

item.title: Religious ties shape how Black Americans define family
item.description: Black Christians are more likely than religiously unaffiliated to consider nonrelatives a part of their families, study shows.

item.title: On the Move: Stringer, Treviño
item.description: Pastoral and associational changes noted in Richmond, Santa Fe, Beeville, and Mathis.

item.title: Obituario: Santiago “Jimmy” García III
item.description: Santiago “Jimmy” García III, líder del ministerio hispano de Baptist General Convention of Texas y pastor durante muchos años, falleció el 18 de febrero. Tenía 76 años.

item.title: Obituary: Santiago “Jimmy” García III
item.description: Santiago “Jimmy” García III, longtime Hispanic ministry leader for the Baptist General Convention of Texas and pastor, died Feb. 18. He was 76.

item.title: Federal court upholds Texas Ten Commandments law
item.description: Louisiana and Texas attorney generals can proceed in requiring public classrooms to display the Ten Commandments, a federal court has ruled, as Arkansas and Ohio wrangle over similar laws.

item.title: Editorial: We are expected to be a voice for the voiceless
item.description: Being a voice for the voiceless requires several things, starting with understanding God's character and expectations.

item.title: Celebrating Churches: Meadowbrook Baptist builds tiny homes
item.description: Volunteers from Meadowbrook Baptist Church in Robinson constructed two tiny homes in the Creekside Community Village in Waco.
